analysis: The code snippet contains a call to `Thread.sleep(NOOP_INTERVAL)` inside the `run()` method of a thread. Before the call, there is no check or validation of the `millis` parameter (`NOOP_INTERVAL`). The value of `NOOP_INTERVAL` is not defined in the snippet, so there is no guarantee it is non-negative; if it is negative, `IllegalArgumentException` will be thrown. The thread could be interrupted at any time, but there is no check for thread interruption before the sleep call. The code does have a `catch(InterruptedException)` that logs and continues, but that is post-exception handling, not avoidance. Therefore, both exception conditions are not avoided by any means in the calling context.
remark: `IllegalArgumentException` is triggered if `NOOP_INTERVAL` is negative, which is not validated before the call. `InterruptedException` is triggered if the thread is interrupted during sleep; there is no prevention of interruption before the call.
